subject: Re: Kickoff: MIR / wtd-Assign — staffing + Corpus dependency
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Staffing: Gustavo Moreau 50% leads reproduction and owns the wtd-Assign training runs; Bilal Novak 40% on dataset prep (synthetic bags across bag sizes, plus the census ingestion); Emeka Pinto 30% on the Evalline wiring; Maren Zhou 20% consulting on schema, since she's mostly on a language project this half.

Compute: modest — the MLP configs run fine on 8 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort, no reservation.

On the Corpus dependency: the v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so our bag-generation jobs on the v1 pipelines can run through the whole project window and well past it — no migration work needs to land before we close in May. I'll still have Emeka write the v2 port plan as part of the design note, but nothing blocks.

One heads-up: the census CSV is 14 GB and the prep script is single-threaded; Bilal may parallelize it rather than wait 9 hours per bag-size sweep.

Santiago
